headline.purpose: Page H1 with a deliberately short line length.

body.purpose: Explanatory prose held to the 66ch publication measure.

mono.purpose: Code, seeds, coefficients, figure labels, and measurements.

shadows.name: floating-resume-light
shadows.purpose: Lifts the floating resume mark only when the contents rail is unavailable.

shadows.name: floating-resume-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark-scheme counterpart for the floating resume mark.

shadows.name: figure-loupe
shadows.purpose: Separates the circular figure inspection lens from its plate.

shadows.name: hero-lens
shadows.purpose: Lifts the cursor-following causal-world lens in the light scheme.

motion.name: publication-ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for interface state transitions.

motion.name: quick-state
motion.purpose: Links, navigation dots, buttons, search, and rail-state changes.

motion.name: chain-drift
motion.purpose: Subtle vertical movement for inactive chapter-chain stations.

motion.name: world-story-morph
motion.purpose: Scroll-selected transformation from code to series, graph, decomposition, and identity.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: 0ms story duration; loupe transitions and chain drift removed
motion.purpose: Preserves evidence while honoring reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary Hero Button
components.description: Navy pill action for starting the documentation path.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pg-ground); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pg-rule); color: var(--pg-ink); font: 500 0.75rem/1 var(--pg-display); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s var(--pg-ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--pg-ease), color 0.2s; } .ds-button:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pg-ink); color: var(--pg-ink); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-link); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button--primary { background: var(--pg-ink); box-shadow: none; color: var(--pg-ground); } .ds-button--primary:hover { background: var(--pg-link); box-shadow: none; color: var(--pg-ground); }

components.name: Secondary Hero Button
components.description: Paper pill for the adjacent reading path.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pg-ground); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pg-rule); color: var(--pg-ink); font: 500 0.75rem/1 var(--pg-display); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s var(--pg-ease), box-shadow 0.2s var(--pg-ease), color 0.2s; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pg-ink); color: var(--pg-ink); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-link); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Atlas Navigation
components.description: Single-row section navigation with a peach current-page station.
components.html: Getting startedGuideExamples
components.css: .ds-atlas-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font-family: var(--pg-display); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-atlas-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; color: var(--pg-ink-2); font: 500 0.72rem/1 var(--pg-display); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s var(--pg-ease); } .ds-atlas-nav a::before { content: ''; width: 0.38rem; height: 0.38rem; border: 1.2px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-atlas-nav a:hover, .ds-atlas-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-atlas-nav a.is-active { color: var(--pg-ink); } .ds-atlas-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-link); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-atlas-nav a.is-active::before { background: var(--pg-peach); border-color: var(--pg-ink); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Quiet header search field that opens into a bordered paper control.
components.css: .ds-search { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.45rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pg-ground); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pg-rule); } .ds-search input { width: 14rem; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--pg-ink); font-family: var(--pg-display); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--pg-ink-3); } .ds-search:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--pg-ink); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-link); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Code Plate
components.description: Hairline source plate for code and executed output.
components.css: .ds-code-plate { margin: 0; padding: 1rem 1.2rem; overflow: auto; border: 1px solid var(--pg-rule); border-radius: 0.35rem; background: var(--pg-plate); color: var(--pg-ink); font: 0.7rem/1.7 var(--pg-mono); font-variant-ligatures: none; }

components.name: Executed Figure Plate
components.description: Numbered white evidence plate with a hairline-separated caption.
components.css: .ds-figure-plate { margin: 0; padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--pg-rule); border-radius: 0.35rem; background: #ffffff; color: var(--pg-ink); } .ds-figure-plate svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-figure-plate figcaption { margin-top: 0.8rem; padding-top: 0.7rem; border-top: 1px solid rgba(12, 31, 64, 0.12); color: var(--pg-ink-2); font: 0.74rem/1.5 var(--pg-text); } .ds-figure-plate figcaption span { margin-right: 0.9rem; color: var(--pg-navy); font: 0.66rem/1 var(--pg-mono); }

components.name: Chapter Chain
components.description: Connected chapter stations that distinguish passed, current, and upcoming reading positions.
components.css: .ds-chain { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-chain::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.3rem; right: 0.3rem; height: 1px; background: var(--pg-rule); } .ds-chain span { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: block; width: 0.62rem; height: 0.62rem; border: 1.3px solid var(--pg-ink-3); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pg-ground); animation: ds-chain-drift 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; } .ds-chain .is-before { border-color: var(--pg-ink); background: var(--pg-ink); } .ds-chain .is-current { width: 0.82rem; height: 0.82rem; border-color: var(--pg-ink); background: var(--pg-peach); } @keyframes ds-chain-drift { from { translate: 0 -1.5px; } to { translate: 0 1.5px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chain span { animation: none; } }

components.name: Resume Mark
components.description: Optional reading-position control with a peach flag and hairline border.
components.css: .ds-resume { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.45rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--pg-rule); border-radius: 0.35rem; background: var(--pg-plate); color: var(--pg-ink); font: 500 0.64rem/1.3 var(--pg-display); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s var(--pg-ease), background-color 0.2s var(--pg-ease); } .ds-resume > span { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.7rem; background: var(--pg-peach); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 50% 75%, 0 100%); } .ds-resume:hover { border-color: var(--pg-ink); } .ds-resume:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pg-link); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The Executed Paper makes a causal model read as an inspectable research publication. Navy typography, source-style figures, and quiet hairlines establish scholarly precision; aqua and periwinkle blooms make the white ground feel observed rather than inert. Evidence is always present as executed output: a world field, a plotted plate, a decomposition, or a measured reading position.

The system is intentionally airy and terse. It uses one display voice for structure, a serif reading voice for explanation, and mono only where the reader is inspecting code, measurements, or data labels. White and soft-white surfaces are separated by rules instead of card piles; color is concentrated in figures, focused states, and the active peach marker.

Light and dark schemes preserve the same publication hierarchy. Dark mode uses navy as the field and lifts plates tonally rather than changing the information model. Motion gives the real generated world and its explanatory sequence a single continuous instrument, while reduced-motion readers receive the same evidence without animation.
keyCharacteristics: Executed figures and the site share a single publication palette and data-label face; causal graphs are the exception and follow Graphviz (see Do's).
Hairline rails and node chains make navigation a reading instrument.
Peach identifies the current, selected, or magnified point of attention.
Plates remain flat; depth belongs to the loupe and the floating resume mark.
The responsive composition preserves evidence first, with the story stage moving ahead of its prose on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Focused Peach Rule
rules.body: Peach names the current or inspected datum: active navigation, current progress nodes, the outcome node, and the time cursor. It is not a general surface fill.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Host Grotesk structures, Source Serif 4 explains, and Fragment Mono measures. Mono is reserved for code, data, and measurement.

rules.name: The Evidence Column Rule
rules.body: Explanatory text stays within the 66ch measure; full-width evidence plates and the home field may exceed it when the data needs room to be inspected.

rules.name: The Lens-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient shadows to publication plates. Depth is reserved for an instrument that temporarily magnifies or resumes reading.

dos: Do use the same navy/aqua/periwinkle/peach figure language in package plots, executed notebooks, and site plates.

Do draw causal graphs in Graphviz's manner, as PyMC's `model_to_graphviz` does: top-to-bottom ranks, black ovals labelled `name ~ type`, plain black arrows, a Times-like serif (STIX), and grey fills by observability (white for latent factors and the baseline, gray90 controls, gray80 channels, gray70 outcome). Dashes mark isolated nulls and the baseline edge; no other colour.
Do keep explanations in the serif reading column and reserve Fragment Mono for code, seeds, coefficients, captions, and other measurements.
Do make a focused or current causal datum peach, with a navy outline where the mark needs to remain precise.
Do preserve both light and dark publication schemes; change the ground and plate tone, not the information hierarchy.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by retaining the world and proof while removing loupe transitions, chain drift, and story interpolation.
donts: Don't introduce colors outside the PyMC Labs navy, aqua, periwinkle, soft-white, and peach families or their tints and shades.
Don't use mono as a display substitute; it is for code, measurements, and figure data labels.
Don't turn ordinary documentation content into shadowed cards; use white plates, tonal washes, and hairlines instead.
Don't use peach as generic decoration; reserve it for the active, selected, inspected, or outcome datum.
Don't create a second figure style for notebooks or package output; executed evidence must look like it belongs to the same publication.
